user.title: Compare electricity tariffs
user.description: Each option is priced on the sensor's last 12 months of hourly statistics, with the regulated tariffs (incl. taxes) published by the CRE and in force each day.

data_description.entite_energie: The sensor used in the Energy dashboard (Linky meter, clamp, etc.).
data_description.heures_creuses: Ranges shown on the bill or the distribution network operator's customer area (Enedis or local operator), e.g. "22:00-06:00" or "02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00". Used to simulate the off-peak option even if your current option is Base. If they changed during the year, add each change after "|" with its date: "22:00-06:00 | 2026-03-15: 02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00".

error.unite: The sensor must be in Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.state_class: The sensor must be cumulative (state_class total or total_increasing), like Energy dashboard sensors.
error.plages_invalides: Unreadable ranges: HH:MM-HH:MM, comma-separated, no overlap; changes: "| YYYY-MM-DD: ranges", increasing dates.
